seo.title: Hemolumi H6 — automated hemostasis analyzer | LabWell
seo.description: Hemolumi H6 is a Snibe hemostasis analyzer for coagulation testing: up to 450 tests/h and 84 sample positions. LabWell supplies it in Ukraine.

T2_hero.lead: Automates coagulation testing with optical detection and a magnetic bead method in one system. Separate sample and reagent positions support routine workflow organization.

T3_about.h2: What Hemolumi H6 is and who it is for
T3_about.text: Hemolumi H6 is an automated Snibe hemostasis analyzer for coagulation testing. It combines optical detection with a magnetic bead method and provides 84 sample positions and 69 reagent positions. According to Snibe, the analyzer supports at least five hours of unattended operation, while reagents remain stable onboard for more than seven days.

items.text: The laboratory gets optical detection and a magnetic bead method in one automated analyzer. Both approaches are used for coagulation testing.
According to Snibe, the system supports at least five hours of unattended operation. This allows part of the workflow to proceed without constant presence at the analyzer.
Onboard reagent stability of more than seven days helps simplify day-to-day workflow planning. Reagents can remain directly in the system for longer.
